title: Validate provider adapter configuration and secret-safe runtime status
verify: Provider/model adapter status distinguishes configured, missing_config, disabled, provider_unavailable, and failed.
Provider credentials and .env values are redacted from context, traces, API responses, logs, Bus, UI Feed, exports, and screenshots.
Missing provider/model config returns structured provider_unavailable or missing_config observations with no fake success.
evidence_required: provider config and redaction test output
VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: Model adapters are harness components, not model-visible tools and not domain authority.
Adapter inputs are context-builder packages and authorized artifact refs, not broad filesystem/database access.
Provider state/caching/retention cannot become project memory authority.
invariants: NEVER use fake, mock, hardcoded, or stubbed product-agent outputs as the MVP runtime/demo path.
NEVER log or export secrets, API keys, tokens, .env values, credentials, or auth material.
